title: Christopher Maher Appearance on Bloomberg TV Surveillance 4.29.26
summary: OceanFirst Bank Chairman and CEO Chris Maher discusses the latest economic environment, 2026 M&A Outlook and the job market.
body_markdown: OceanFirst Bank Chairman and CEO Chris Maher sits down with Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz, and Annmarie Hordern to discuss AI spend, growth from technology, and what how it fits within the current financial environment.
